shared_elements: low relief carving of figures in strict profile
human figure in profile with visible arm(s) raised/extended
quadruped legs and hooved/clawed feet on a groundline
frieze-like horizontal composition with figures on a baseline
justification: Both are profile-view low-relief friezes with human male figures on a groundline, one holding a straight rod-like implement diagonally, and both include a four-legged body; that is about the extent of the correspondence. A shows a naturalistic horse-drawn chariot with wheel and driver plus a rosette border, while B shows composite winged monsters — a bird-headed, feather-bodied griffin-demon and a winged helmeted figure with elaborately patterned wings and garments — with no vehicle, no wheel and no floral band.this is generic profile-relief convention rather than a shared scene.
